title: Booking: fixes to the book-and-pay page
text: A refused booking on the page where a person books and pays a paid call used to look like nothing happened: the message was wiped. Now it stays on screen, and the time the person picked is written out under the times. A stopped or expired paid link no longer opens your free Meet and Greet call: it opens the payment page, which says nothing is due. For a link made for someone new, the payment now goes to the email the person typed when they booked, not a mistyped one. Emails with an apostrophe (like d'amico@) can book. Cancel the call on a call that is already paid now warns you that nothing is refunded. If Calendly is slow, the person is told to look for Calendly's email, and you get a report naming the time to check.
points: Open a paid link, pick a time and check the line that names it
Cancel the call on a paid call: read the warning on the button

steps.name: Pick a time
steps.detail: The chosen time is written out under the times.

steps.name: Press Book and pay
steps.detail: The call is booked and the card payment opens.

steps.name: If it is refused
steps.detail: The message stays on screen and the times reload.

steps.name: If the link was stopped
steps.detail: The payment page says nothing is due, never a free call.
